summary: Phase 2 landed per DESIGN.md §10. First-run flow now ends at a self-signed identityAttestation (display_name + pubkey + created_at on the Merkle field tree, tier routine). Held attestation renders as a card on home above the IdentityCard. Settings screen with cloud-sync toggle (default ON), passphrase-confirmed local encrypted-backup download, sign-out. Backup-status banner on home: off / pending / stale > 24h / fresh-no-banner. Storage layer adds unencrypted prefsStore (cloudSync, lastRemoteSync) keyed by ownerId; walletStore.save respects the pref and records lastRemoteSync. WalletProvider state machine extended (checking → first-login | locked → needs-identity? → unlocked); passphrase held in useRef so attestation creation can save without re-prompting, cleared on sign-out. PLAN.md rewritten to match DESIGN.md's six phases — Phases 1 and 2 marked DONE.

why.text: Operator greenlit with 'Yes' after the Phase 1 close-out which named Phase 2 as the next move. DESIGN.md §10 prescribes the exact deliverables: identity attestation first-run flow, settings backup posture, home-screen backup banner. The same DESIGN.md preamble required the PLAN.md update to happen in the same session as the Phase 2 commit so the two docs converge on a single phase numbering. Architecture choices preserved: efficient modules (settings is its own feature slug with a manifest), cheap fast shell (Settings lazy-loaded, login surface unchanged), tapit-attest composition (identityAttestation + wallet.sign + wallet.hold + wallet.exportEncrypted — no new crypto written).

files_changed: 18 files: 6 created (createIdentityAttestation, saveWallet, DisplayNamePrompt, AttestationCard, prefsStore, settings/*) + 12 modified (WalletContext, WalletProvider, HomeScreen, walletStore, storage manifest, wallet-core manifest, App, features-registry, PLAN, plus comms artifacts)
outcome.tests_passing: root: 16/16 (4-test manifest-registry correctly picked up the new settings slug). tapit-attest: 74/74 active, 4 skipped (unchanged this session)
outcome.notes: Commit c87e8a2 pushed to claude/compare-library-wallet-OW5FF AND to main (fast-forward direct-push). Bundle posture: login surface unchanged at ~110KB gzipped; WalletProvider grew from 5.91KB→9.67KB (gz 2.09→3.03KB) for the identity flow + display-name prompt; HomeScreen grew from 1.59KB→3.38KB (gz 0.82→1.39KB) for the attestation card + banner; new SettingsScreen chunk at 3.95KB gz 1.63KB lazy. NOT VERIFIED in a browser — sandbox has no browser. Operator should walk login → passphrase → display-name → home with identity card → settings → cloud-toggle → local-export → sign-out → re-login → unlock → home still showing identity card.

uncertainty: The state-machine transition from needs-identity to unlocked depends on the just-created attestation being findable via wallet.holdings() — which calls loadVerified on the store and filters by verifyEnvelope().valid. If the self-signed routine-tier attestation fails to verify under the new quorum-of-good rule for any subtle reason, the user would land back at needs-identity instead of unlocked. The wallet test suite covers verifyEnvelope on signed envelopes but not specifically this hold→holdings round-trip on an identityAttestation. Add a vitest integration test in a follow-up if browser verification surfaces anything unexpected.
next: Operator verifies Phases 1+2 end-to-end in a browser with real Supabase credentials. If clean, Phase 3 (social recovery designation + simulated recovery cycle) is the next cutting session. If anything stalls (e.g., the held identity attestation does not re-verify on re-unlock), the next session diagnoses and fixes before proceeding.
